title: Main Idea & Details
subject: Language Arts
description: What is the story MOSTLY about?
steps: The MAIN IDEA is what the story or paragraph is MOSTLY about.
DETAILS are the smaller facts that tell more about the main idea.
Think of an umbrella: the main idea is the umbrella, details are underneath it. ☂️
Ask yourself: 'What is this all about, in one sentence?'

questions.correct: What the story is mostly about
options: What the story is mostly about

questions.correct: Tell more about the main idea
options: Tell more about the main idea

questions.prompt: 'Dogs make great pets. They are loyal. They love to play.' What's the main idea?
questions.hint: The other sentences give details about it.

questions.prompt: In the umbrella picture, the details go...
questions.hint: The main idea covers them all!
